LightningMessageChannel.description:
Message channel for broadcasting Opportunity filter criteria across unrelated LWC components on the same Lightning page. Published by opportunityFilterBar; subscribed by opportunityMetricsTile and opportunityList.
LMS replaces the legacy pubsub pattern (fireEvent/handleEvent) and Aura application events. It works across: - Components with no parent-child relationship - Components in different regions of a Lightning page - LWC and Aura components on the same page - Standard and custom Lightning pages

lightningMessageFields.description: Opportunity Stage picklist value to filter on. 'All' means no stage filter.
Minimum Opportunity Amount filter. Null means no lower bound.
